items.prompt: Check for bent, dented, or broken parts and inspect seat condition.
Check under the unit for fluid leaks.
Check tyres and wheels for damage; confirm wheel nuts are present and tight.
Check forks or carpet probe are in place, straight, and secured by locking pins.
Check chains, hoses, and cables are secure, with no broken links or loose rollers.
Check overhead guard and load backrest condition and security.
Check flashing, head, brake, and indicator lights and the horn.
Check all dash warning lamps and gauges operate correctly.
Check engine oil is between the minimum and maximum marks.
Check radiator water/coolant level, hoses, and leaks.
Check fan belt adjustment and tension.
Check for fuel leaks and confirm the tank cap is fitted.
Check air cleaner and pre-cleaner are installed and operating; clean where required.
Check machine operation and all fitted functions.
Check forward and reverse operation with no unusual noise.
Check horn and reverse beeper.
Check park brake and foot brake operate correctly.
Check the inch pedal engages and disengages drive.
Check steering lock to lock with no unusual noise; grease where applicable.
Check raise/lower, tilt, side-shift, and fork-position controls as fitted.
Check mast is greased and tilt and bottom pivots are secure.
Check neutral start, speed governor, and forward/reverse interlock as fitted.
Record the service meter reading.
